```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} [DecidableEq α] : StrictMono f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄, a ∉ s → f s < f (insert a s) := by
  intro h
  split
  · intro s a ha
    rw [insert_eq_iff]
    rcases eq_or_mem (f s) (f (insert a s)) with (h1 | h2)
    · exact False.elim (h _ _ ha h1)
    · exact h _ _ ha h2
  · intro h'
    intros s t hst
    by_cases h1 : s = t
    · exact hst
    · obtain ⟨a, h2, h3⟩ := set_diff_eq.mono hst
      have := h' s a h2
      exact this.trans h3
```
